outcome: maternal complications (shock, postpartum hemorrhage, coagulation failure, preterm labor,  increased rate of cesarean section)
cohort: 840 women with antepartum hemorrhage admitted to MGM medical college and MYH hospital in Indore, India between January 2018 and January 2021
finding: Antepartum hemorrhage (APH) was associated with high maternal morbidity, including increased rates of anemia and postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: Of the 840 participants, 390 had cesarean sections and 450 delivered vaginally; the primary indication for cesarean section was placenta previa (240/390).
